当开发者需要在HarmonyOS应用中嵌入3D模型展示、构建3D交互场景或实现3D动画效果时，应使用ArkGraphics 3D
典型场景包括电商应用中的商品3D预览、游戏中的3D角色与场景渲染、教育培训中的3D模型演示、以及需要自定义灯光、相机和材质的沉浸式3D体验
如果开发者需要快速展示一个已有的glTF模型，可以使用自动场景模式直接加载；如果需要精细控制3D场景中的相机位置、灯光效果、材质属性和着色器逻辑，则应使用自定义场景模式，通过ArkTS API逐个创建和管理场景节点

do_not_use_when: 需求是音视频编解码、封装/解封装、硬件编解码加速或处理HDR Vivid、Audio Vivid、可变帧率媒体流，应改用 avcodec-kit / The requirement is audio/video encoding-decoding, muxing-demuxing, hardware codec acceleration, or handling HDR Vivid, Audio Vivid, and variable-frame-rate streams; use avcodec-kit instead

需求是媒体播放、录制、屏幕录制、转码、元数据提取、缩略图生成或HDR视频处理，应改用 media-kit / The task is media playback, recording, screen recording, transcoding, metadata extraction, thumbnail generation, or HDR video processing; use media-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成并启用 ArkGraphics 3D 对应SDK/能力，目标设备支持3D渲染 / The project has integrated and enabled the ArkGraphics 3D SDK/capability, and the target device supports 3D rendering
应用资源中已准备可访问的3D资产与相关资源，如 .gltf/.glb、纹理图片或 .shader 文件 / Required 3D assets and related resources are available in app resources, such as .gltf/.glb, texture images, or .shader files
页面已具备可承载3D内容的UI组件或渲染容器，并完成基础生命周期接入 / The page has a UI component or rendering container capable of hosting 3D content, with basic lifecycle integration completed
inputs: glTF模型文件或资源路径 / glTF model file or resource path
场景配置数据（相机、灯光、节点） / scene configuration data (camera, lights, nodes)
材质、纹理或.shader着色器资源 / material, texture, or .shader resources
动画名称、状态或控制参数 / animation names, states, or control parameters
outputs: 加载后的glTF模型或场景资源（.gltf/.glb） / Loaded glTF model or scene resource (.gltf/.glb)
场景节点对象（Node） / Scene node object (Node)
光源对象（Light，如方向光、点光源、聚光灯） / Light object (Light, such as directional light, point light, spotlight)
环境资源对象（Environment，用于天空盒和环境光照） / Environment resource object (Environment, for skybox and image-based lighting)
图片/纹理资源对象（Image，来源于png、jpg、ktx） / Image or texture resource object (Image, from png, jpg, ktx)
PBR材质对象（PBR Material） / PBR material object (PBR Material)
自定义Shader材质对象（Shader Material） / Custom shader material object (Shader Material)
着色器资源文件（.shader） / Shader resource file (.shader)
动画对象或动画控制句柄（Animation） / Animation object or animation control handle (Animation)
渲染后的3D场景画面 / Rendered 3D scene output

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建或接入3D场景承载与渲染入口 / The code creates or wires up a 3D scene host and rendering entry point
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add code that initializes or mounts an ArkGraphics 3D scene/view/container rather than unrelated UI only?

postconditions.statement: 代码中已加载3D资源或显式创建场景节点（如模型、相机、灯光） / The code loads 3D assets or explicitly creates scene nodes such as a model, camera, or light
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show ArkGraphics 3D usage that either loads a glTF asset or constructs scene nodes like camera, light, or model entities?

postconditions.statement: 如需求涉及材质、环境或动画，代码中已加入对应配置或控制逻辑 / If the task involves materials, environment, or animation, the code includes the corresponding configuration or control logic
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the requested feature mentions materials, environment, shaders, or animation, do the edits include matching setup or control code for those features?
